proposed_widenings.name: grant_cover
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier explicitly grants Three-Quarters Cover to creatures in or behind the wall. Cover is a mechanical effect that modifies attack rolls against affected creatures. No cover-granting atom exists in the v4 taxonomy or the current EffectAtom union.

proposed_widenings.name: AreaShapeDescriptor.ring
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell offers a ringed wall option (60 ft diameter, 20 ft high, 5 ft thick). This is a hollow cylindrical shell — creatures inside the ring are NOT in the wall's space. The existing `cylinder` shape is a solid volume and would incorrectly mark interior creatures as being in the wall. A new area shape variant is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.oncePer
proposed_widenings.justification: Blade Barrier fires a save on entry AND at end of turn, but the SRD caps this at once per turn regardless of how many triggers fire. Encoding both `on_creature_enters_area` and `on_creature_ends_turn_in_area` without a deduplication mechanism implies a creature could save twice on the same turn. A new field (e.g., `oncePerTurn: true`) on OngoingOperation is needed to express this cap.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes that save only once per turn.

notes: The core damage mechanic (Dex save, 6d10 Force, half on success), `area_is_difficult_terrain`, and `initialPhase` for creatures already in the wall at cast time all map cleanly to existing surface shapes. The blocking issues are: (1) `grant_cover` is not in v4 and cannot be approximated without a new atom; (2) the ring wall shape requires a new AreaShapeDescriptor variant; (3) encoding both entry and end-of-turn triggers without once-per-turn deduplication would produce a mechanically incorrect trace. Not encoding to avoid a misleading trace.
